{{Top|leg}}
A '''marine docking facility''' was, like a standard [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]], an area where a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] could dock; however, marine facilities catered specifically to [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Iyra]]. Indeed, the Iyra preferred to visit [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that offered such facilities.<ref name="GG4b">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
